_note: Curated snapshot of real Tempe, AZ venues (names/coords/cuisine reflect OpenStreetMap/Geoapify data). Fields 'price_per_person', 'vegan', 'vibe', 'close_hour' and 'website_content' are annotations used as GROUND TRUTH for evaluation. The baseline's structured tools intentionally expose only the subset a free API actually returns (name, category, cuisine, coords, website, sparse opening_hours) — price and vibe are NOT exposed and must be recovered by the Phase-2 web-fetch enrichment agent.

venues.name: Pita Jungle
venues.website_content: Pita Jungle, Mill Ave Tempe. Mediterranean. Extensive vegan & vegetarian menu. Entrees $12-22 (about $18/person). Relaxed, casual, health-conscious vibe. Open daily 11am-10pm.

venues.name: Green New American Vegetarian
venues.website_content: Green - 100% vegan comfort food, Tempe. Bowls, tso soy nuggets, shakes. ~$14-18/person. Casual, chill. Open Mon-Sat 11am-9pm.

venues.name: Cornish Pasty Co
venues.website_content: Cornish Pasty Co - handmade pasties, Tempe. Some vegetarian pasties; limited vegan. ~$13-17/person. Dark, cozy, quirky cave-like interior. Open till midnight.

venues.name: Culinary Dropout
venues.website_content: Culinary Dropout, Tempe - gastropub, pretzel fondue, fried chicken. ~$25-35/person. Lively, trendy, loud, big patio. Open till 11pm.

venues.name: Loco Patron
venues.website_content: Loco Patron - Mill Ave Mexican & tequila bar. Vegan-friendly (impossible tacos, veggie fajitas). ~$18-24/person. Lively, festive, rooftop. Open late.

venues.name: House of Tricks
venues.website_content: House of Tricks - upscale New American in a historic Tempe cottage garden. ~$40-50/person. Romantic, quiet, date-night. Reservations recommended. Dinner Tue-Sat.

venues.name: The Chuckbox
venues.website_content: The Chuckbox - classic charcoal burgers near ASU. Cash-friendly, ~$10-14/person. No vegan options. Divey, casual. Closes 9pm.

venues.name: Snooze an A.M. Eatery
venues.website_content: Snooze - breakfast & brunch only. Vegan pancakes available. ~$16-20/person. Bright, casual. CLOSES 2:30PM - not open for dinner.

venues.name: The Gelato Spot
venues.website_content: The Gelato Spot - gelato & sorbet (dairy-free sorbet is vegan). ~$6-8/person. Chill dessert stop. Open till 11pm.

venues.name: Cartel Coffee Lab
venues.website_content: Cartel Coffee Lab - specialty coffee, oat milk available (vegan). ~$5-7/person. Chill, quiet, hipster. Open till 10pm.

venues.name: Casey Moore's Oyster House
venues.website_content: Casey Moore's - historic house bar with big shaded patio. Beers & apps ~$12-18/person. Chill, laid-back, great patio. Open till 2am.

venues.name: The Handlebar
venues.website_content: The Handlebar - Mill Ave bar, games, live music. ~$10-15/person. Lively, loud, energetic. Open till 2am.

venues.name: Zipps Sports Grill
venues.website_content: Zipps Sports Grill - wings, beers, TVs. ~$13-17/person. Lively sports-bar vibe. Open till midnight.
